readerCopy.body: The action in front of you may force you to choose between an old reflex and a different result. When Mars opposes the South Node, a deadline, conflict, boundary, or practical demand can make the familiar strategy impossible to ignore. You may know how to fight this fight, but that does not mean you have to. Use the strength the old experience gave you without reenacting the whole pattern. The goal is not to prove you can survive the same situation again.
